site.name: Freelance Money Calculator
site.tagline: Free calculators that tell you what to charge.
site.metaTitle: Freelance Money Calculator — Free Rate Calculators
site.metaDescription: Free, no-signup calculators that help freelancers work out what to charge to reach the income they actually need. Works in any currency.

home.heading: Work out what you should be charging
home.intro: Freelancers routinely undercharge because the arithmetic hides the real cost of unpaid time, business expenses and taxes. These calculators do that arithmetic. No account, no cost, nothing leaves your browser.
home.emptyState: The first calculator is being built and will appear here shortly.

targetRate.metaTitle: Freelance Rate Calculator — What Should You Charge?
targetRate.metaDescription: Work out the hourly rate you need to reach your target monthly income, after unpaid time, business expenses and taxes. Free, instant, no signup.

ui.question: How much should I charge per hour to reach my desired freelance income?
ui.headline: Your recommended hourly rate
ui.retention: You keep {percent} of every amount you invoice.
ui.prompt: Fill in every field to see your rate.
ui.incomeLegend: What you want to take home
ui.taxNote: Tax is applied to what remains after the platform fee and expenses, because both are normally deductible.
ui.disclaimer: Tax, platform fee and expense rates are estimates you set yourself — they vary by country, contract and situation. This calculator is general guidance, not tax, financial or legal advice. Check anything that matters with a qualified professional.

targetMonthlyNetIncome.label: Target monthly income
targetMonthlyNetIncome.help: What you want left over each month, after everything below.

currency.label: Currency
currency.help: Amounts are shown in this currency. Nothing is converted.

hoursPerDay.label: Working hours per day
hoursPerDay.help: Hours at work, not only the ones you invoice.

weeksPerYear.label: Working weeks per year
weeksPerYear.help: 52 minus holidays, public holidays and sick days.

billablePercent.label: Billable hours
billablePercent.help: Share of your working hours a client actually pays for. The rest is admin, sales and proposals. Most freelancers overestimate this.

taxPercent.label: Tax and contributions
taxPercent.help: Your estimated rate on profit, including social contributions.

platformFeePercent.label: Platform fee
platformFeePercent.help: Marketplace commission on each invoice. Use 0 if you invoice clients directly.

overheadPercent.label: Business expenses
overheadPercent.help: Software, equipment, insurance and similar, as a share of what you invoice.

targetMonthlyNetIncome.notPositive: Enter the monthly income you want, as a number above zero.

billablePercent.outOfRange: Enter between 1% and 100%. At 0% there would be nothing to invoice.

taxPercent.consumesEverything: At 100% tax no rate would leave anything behind.

deductions.exceedGross: The platform fee and expenses together take 100% or more of every invoice, so no rate can work. Tax is not part of this limit — it applies to what is left after these two.

billablePercent.optimistic: Over 90% billable is rare over a full year. Admin, sales and unpaid revisions add up.

workload.unsustainable: That is more than 60 hours a week. Worth checking the schedule is one you can hold.

weeksPerYear.noTimeOff: More than 50 weeks leaves almost no holiday. Your rate has to fund the time you do not work.

deductions.severe: Deductions take most of what you invoice. Worth confirming the rates before you rely on the result.

legal.privacyBody: This site does not use cookies, does not track you and has no user accounts. Everything you type into a calculator is processed in your browser and never sent to a server. If analytics or advertising is introduced later, this page will be rewritten before that happens, not after.
legal.termsBody: These calculators are provided free and as-is, for general guidance only. They are not financial, tax or legal advice. Rates and tax rules vary by country and by situation, so verify any figure that matters with a qualified professional before acting on it.
legal.cookiesBody: This site currently sets no cookies of any kind. No consent banner is shown because there is nothing to consent to. If advertising is introduced later, this page and the privacy policy will be updated first.
legal.aboutBody: Freelance Money Calculator is a small, free set of tools for people who invoice their own clients. It exists because the arithmetic behind a sustainable rate is genuinely easy to get wrong, and most freelancers get it wrong in the same direction.
legal.contactBody: Questions, corrections or a calculator you wish existed? Open an issue on the project's GitHub repository.
legal.pendingNotice: This page is a working draft and will be expanded before the site is submitted to any advertising network.
